title: DevGate runner-monitor registry (instance state, never committed)

_comment.description: Explanatory prose for a human reading the redacted example. Declared here because the example carries it and this schema closes itself to undeclared keys — an example that violates its own schema teaches the wrong shape.

token_salt.description: Per-registry salt for heartbeat-token hashing (mon-sec-02). Generated on first use and persisted; heartbeat verifiers are stored only as salted hashes.

enrollment_tokens.description: One-time enrollment tokens; consumed on successful /enroll.

toolchain_requests.description: Open and settled toolchain requests, one row per (lane, tool) (mon-tc-02). The hub is the system of record for these; Mission Control reads them and never stores a copy. Rows are keyed by lane and tool so a partial approval of a multi-tool profile is expressible (mon-tc-04). Absent for a registry written before this capability existed, which reads as an empty set — an empty set is 'nobody has asked for anything', never 'every lane is provisioned' (mon-tc-06).

address.description: The runner's routable (tailnet) address, published by the spoke at enroll and refreshed on every heartbeat. Service discovery resolves a service's host_alias against this; null until the spoke publishes one (mon-svcdisco-01).

heartbeat_token_hash.description: Salted sha256 of the heartbeat token — the plaintext token is never stored (mon-sec-02). Null after revocation.

image_digest.description: The digest-qualified evaluator ref this host would gate with, or null when it cannot serve the pinned image (img-cycle-03). Null is UNKNOWN, never healthy.

image_reason.description: Why image_digest is null, in the host's own words. The vocabulary the shipped probe uses, one fault per fix: 'not provisioned: <vars> not set' | 'podman not on PATH' | 'store does not exist: <path>' | 'podman info failed for the configured store' | 'store mismatch: podman reports <a>, configured <b>' | 'pinned image absent from the store (not pulled)'. Free text from an untrusted-as-input host, so consumers must render it, never match on it.

image_pin_divergence.description: The host's report that the registry's served digest for the published tag no longer equals the recorded image_manifest_digest (img-cycle-05). Non-empty string names both digests ('served <image>:<tag> is <served> but the record is <record> — a re-pin is due'). Null means the host checked and they agree, OR it could not check — the two are deliberately the same value here because both mean 'no divergence was observed', and the check itself is a repository-reachable fact the publish job and the hub also carry. A key left out entirely means an older helper that does not report this field. Free text from an untrusted-as-input host, so consumers must render it, never match on it. Divergence is a fact about the repository, not a fault on the host (design D6): the tick still succeeds.

scan_state.description: The last fleet secret sweep this host reported (secret-scan-07), or null when it has no scan state to report. Null is UNKNOWN, never healthy: a host that has never been swept is not a swept-and-clean host. 'unreadable' is set when a report exists on the host and would not parse, and it is NOT an empty fleet.

repos.description: One record per declared repository. A repository the sweep could not fetch appears here with its state and reason rather than being omitted.

state.description: The sweep's own vocabulary: clean | findings | unfetchable | unscannable.

unreadable.description: Why this host's report could not be read, or null when it was read. Free text from an untrusted-as-input host, so consumers must render it, never match on it.

lane_image_ref.description: The container reference this lane's runner image was built from (mon-tc-05). Separate from image_digest ON PURPOSE: image_digest is the coherence EVALUATOR ref and img-cycle-05 compares that tag's served digest; lane image identity is a different fact about a different image and conflating the two would join lane evidence to evaluator state. Null until a build job reports it. Free text from an untrusted-as-input host, so consumers must render it, never match on it.

lane_image_digest.description: Digest of the runner image this lane is actually running, reported by a build job and later confirmed by the lane's own heartbeat (mon-tc-05). Distinct from the evaluator image_digest above. Null means unreported, which is not 'the lane runs an unpinned image' and is never healthy.

toolchain_profile_id.description: The reviewed toolchain profile this lane is required to satisfy (mon-tc-01). Trusted input: a heartbeat can never set, widen, or rename it. Null means NO REVIEWED ASSIGNMENT — the lane requires nothing has been decided — which is a different answer from the profile named 'none', and the two must never render alike. An id outside the spec's profile table is refused rather than stored.

coverage.description: What this lane's last gap report was (mon-tc-06). Enumerates only the states a hub may STORE: 'reported' (a gap field arrived), 'never-reported' (a spoke that has not sent one since this capability shipped), 'probe-failed' (the last probe run was incomplete). 'stale' is deliberately NOT storable — it is derived from last_gap_report_at against TOOL_REQUEST_STALE_AFTER_S at read time, because a stored 'stale' becomes a lie the moment a heartbeat arrives that nobody has re-rendered. Absent reads as 'never-reported'; it is not evidence of a complete toolchain.

last_gap_report_at.description: When this lane last sent a missing_tools field, whether or not the list was empty (mon-tc-06). Drives the derived 'stale' coverage state. Null until the lane first reports a gap; absence is 'never-reported', never 'up to date'.

toolchain_rejections.description: Gap reports this lane submitted that were refused, counted by reason code (mon-tc-01: a rejection is 'recorded as a code and an incrementing counter'). The rejected VALUE is never stored, in any field, log line, or audit row — only which rule it broke and how often, so an operator can tell a typo-prone spoke from a hostile one without holding a copy of what it sent. Keys are fixed code strings; an empty array and an absent key both mean 'never rejected anything'.

id.description: Stable row id (tcr-NNNN). The (lane, tool) pair is the identity that deduplicates reports (mon-tc-02); id exists so a decision can name the row it decided without the caller restating its key.

lane.description: Hub runner_name (mon-tc-02). A lane Mission Control has not linked is reported as 'unmapped', never silently dropped.

tool.description: One vocabulary member (mon-tc-01). Exact byte value, never normalized; 'g++' must survive storage, export and render unchanged.

required_profile.description: The profile this row was opened against, recorded so a fulfilled request can name what it was fulfilled against after the profile changes (mon-tc-01). Trusted input, never spoke-supplied.

version.description: Compare-and-swap counter, incremented on every transition (mon-tc-04). A decision at an already-applied version returns that outcome instead of transitioning twice.

last_seen.description: Advanced by every re-report of the same (lane, tool) gap; the row is NOT duplicated (mon-tc-02: a lane whose image never gains the tool re-reports every 300s).

actor.description: The operator's actor claim stored exactly as presented (mon-tc-03). v1 issues every decision from one credential, so a shared principal is the expected shape and must stay visible as such rather than being inferred into per-operator attribution.

decision_note.description: Operator's reason, capped at DECISION_NOTE_MAX_CHARS and refused rather than truncated. Rendered escaped; never reaches a builder input, a command, or a profile lookup (mon-tc-03, task 2.6).

nonces.description: Consumed nonces, kept so a replay is refused rather than applied twice (mon-tc-03).

builder_identity.description: Which builder reported the evidence (mon-tc-05). Only a builder credential may supply it; a digest offered under an operator or runner credential is refused.

lane_image_digest.description: The built image digest this row is waiting for a lane to converge onto. Present with state 'built' does NOT mean fulfilled: convergence needs this digest AND a passing probe in a later heartbeat (mon-tc-05).

suppression_until.description: When a denial stops suppressing re-reports (mon-tc-04/mon-tc-06). Set on denial from TOOL_REQUEST_SUPPRESSION_DAYS; a report inside the window advances the suppression counter without changing state, a report after it reopens the row.

suppressed_reports.description: Re-reports swallowed while this row was denied (mon-tc-04 'no state change; suppression counter').

history.description: Append-only transition audit (mon-tc-04). One record per decision, refusal and transition, in the fixed shape mon-tc-03 defines; nothing rewrites or removes an entry, and transitions outside the normative table never reach it.
